name: comp-265
title: Histogram Range Slider
blurb: Dual-range slider with a histogram or frequency distribution overlay.
description: A range slider with a histogram background showing data distribution, common for image or signal filtering.
use_when: Filtering data with visual distribution context (e.g., histogram equalization).
avoid_when: When histogram data is unavailable or irrelevant.
a11y: Histogram is visual; does not convey meaning to screenreader users.
